quote: The SPAD is basically a photodiode whose p-n junction (Fig. 1b ) is reverse biased above its breakdown voltage V bd , such that a single photon incident on the active (i.e. photosensitive) device area can create an electron-hole pair and thus trigger an avalanche of secondary carriers.

value: photon detection probability
quote: The most important is the photon detection probability (PDP), which represents the avalanche probability of the device in response to photon absorption at a given wavelength.

value: dark count rate
quote: Other important parameters are the dark count rate (DCR), i.e. the observed avalanche rate in the absence of light, and afterpulsing, which introduces false events that are correlated in time with previous detections 7 .

value: fill factor
quote: When SPADs are grouped in imagers one must consider electrical and optical crosstalk and the fill factor, which denotes the ratio between the photosensitive area and the total pixel area.

value: photon detection efficiency
quote: The SPAD’s fill factor obviously affects the overall imager sensitivity, given that it is multiplied by the PDP to give the overall photon detection efficiency (PDE).

value: quenching
